name: Eugenio Siena
features: olive skin, dark hair, dark eyes, narrow face, thin build, quiet determined expression
bio: Cousin of Giuseppe Campari and an Alfa Romeo mechanic and test driver under Enzo Ferrari before joining Scuderia Ferrari in 1930. Siena won the Spa 24 Hours in 1932 with Antonio Brivio and later ran his own Scuderia Siena. He was killed at the 1938 Tripoli Grand Prix driving an Alfa Romeo Tipo 312.
